content: Keep k3s-bundled Traefik (v3.7.4 ships with k3s v1.36.2+k3s1): zero-install, HelmChartConfig customization, auto service discovery. ingress-nginx requires disabling Traefik and manual install; no benefit behind an upstream NPM reverse proxy where TLS/routing at ingress is simple. NPM forwards myapp.domain to Traefik LB; use standard Ingress resources for portability.
